sentences.text:
By this Application under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code, the Applicants i.e. husband, mother-in-law and father-in-law of Respondent No.2, accused in CR No. 0107 of 2023, dated 1 st May 2023, registered with Kothrud Police Station, District Pune,
under Sections 498A, 504, 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code, are seeking quashing of the said crime, with the consent of Respondent No.2, the informant.

sentences.text: Mr. Pachundkar, learned Advocate appearing for Respondent No.2 tendered across the bar her Affidavit dated 7 th August 2025, duly Osk 7-Apl-1027-2023.doc affirmed before the Assistant Registrar of this Court.
The copy of Marriage Petition No. F-1469 of 2022 for divorce by mutual consent is annexed to the said Affidavit.
He submitted that, as per the 'Terms and Conditions' of the said Petition, the Respondent No.2 is giving her consent for quashing of the crime in question.
In para No.5 thereof, the Respondent No.2 has given her no objection for quashing of the present crime.

2.1) Respondent No.2 is personally present in the Court and through her Advocate reiterates the contents of her Affidavit dated 7 th August 2025 and her 'no objection' for quashing of the crime in question.

3) In view thereof, Criminal Application (A.P.L.) is allowed in terms of prayer clause (a).
 ( RAJESH S. PATIL, J. ) ( A.S. GADKARI, J.
